Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Complete production readiness - security, validation, and audit logging

SECURITY ENHANCEMENTS:
- Add authentication to all API endpoints \(scheduling, sync, analytics, admin\)
- Implement role-based authorization \(requireAuth, requireAdmin, requireDeveloper\)
- Add security headers: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, XSS Protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
- Secure test endpoint with developer-only access
- WCOnline sync endpoints now require admin role

INPUT VALIDATION:
- Create comprehensive Zod validation schemas \(email, UUID, date, time\)
- Add validation helpers: validateBody, parseSearchParams
- Validate appointment creation, queries, and all user inputs
- Implement proper error messages for validation failures

RATE LIMITING:
- Add in-memory rate limiting utility with configurable limits
- Apply strict rate limiting to login \(5 req/min\)
- Apply very strict rate limiting to sync and exports \(2 req/min\)
- Include proper 429 responses with Retry-After headers

AUDIT LOGGING:
- Create production logger with development-only debug logging
- Add audit trail for user logins
- Log role changes and user creation
- Track WCOnline sync operations
- Log CSV data exports with record counts

PAGINATION:
- Add pagination to admin users endpoint \(50/page, max 100\)
- Enhance appointments endpoint with validated pagination
- Include total count and page calculation

NEW UTILITIES:
- lib/auth.ts - Enhanced with hasRole, requireRole, requireAdmin, requireDeveloper
- lib/validation.ts - Comprehensive Zod schemas and validation helpers
- lib/logger.ts - Production-safe logging with audit support
- lib/rate-limit.ts - In-memory rate limiting \(upgradeable to Redis\)

DOCUMENTATION:
- docs/PRODUCTION-READINESS-FIXES.md - Complete security audit report
- docs/HTTP-STATUS-CODES.md - HTTP status code usage guide
- docs/PRODUCTION-DEPLOYMENT-CHECKLIST.md - Deployment and testing guide

MODIFIED ENDPOINTS:
- All /api/scheduling/* routes - Added authentication
- All /api/sync/wconline/* routes - Added admin auth, rate limiting, audit logging
- /api/analytics/export/csv - Added auth, rate limiting, audit logging
- /api/admin/users - Added pagination and proper auth
- /api/admin/set-role - Added rate limiting and audit logging
- /api/auth/login - Added rate limiting and audit logging
- /api/test/db - Secured with developer-only access

CONFIGURATION:
- next.config.mjs - Added security headers configuration

This commit brings the application to production-ready status with comprehensive
security, validation, rate limiting, and audit logging. All critical and high
priority security issues have been addressed.
EOF
\)")
